headline: On October 19, 2025: French Crown Jewels stolen in Louvre heist
captionCards: Theft underscores the enduring allure and value of historical artifacts
instagramCaption:
The Louvre Museum was the site of a daring heist. \\[On October 19, 2025, pieces of the French Crown Jewels were successfully stolen from the Louvre in Paris. The jewels, which include historic crowns and diadems, were symbols of royal power from 752 to 1870. Despite most being sold off in 1885, surviving pieces like the Regent Diamond and the 105-carat Côte-de-Bretagne red spinel, carved into a dragon, were on display. This theft highlights the ongoing allure and value of these historical artifacts. \\What do you think should be done to protect such valuable treasures? \\Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
